svg.title: 5,5′-Dithiobis(2-nitrobenzoic acid)
svg.desc: Ellman reagent connectivity in the free-acid reference form. Nitro groups are ortho to carboxyl and disulfide groups are at each ring position 5. This is not the colored assay product or measured buffer speciation. Reference connectivity; any computed conformer is illustrative and is not measured solution or surface geometry.
